verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Mailchimp's Marketing API can create contacts/audiences (mailchimp-docs-4) and send campaigns (mailchimp-docs-5, which sends immediately for non-RSS campaigns), plus generative AI content features (mailchimp-docs-11), but there is no documented endpoint or workflow for drafting a campaign, scheduling/queuing it, and leaving it pending for human approval before send. No mention of a review/approval gate or draft-then-schedule flow for agent-initiated campaigns.
